name: itglue-mcp
description: MCP server for IT Glue - access organizations, configurations, passwords, and documents through AI assistants
long_description: Provides AI assistants with structured access to your IT Glue documentation platform. Browse organizations, configurations, flexible assets, passwords, and documents through the Model Context Protocol.

itglue_jwt.title: IT Glue JWT (optional)
itglue_jwt.description: Optional fallback for document-folder operations. Folder access is API-key-first (IT Glue is rolling out a public Document Folders resource across tenants in 2026); a JWT is only used if your tenant's API key cannot access folders yet. JWTs are short-lived (~2h) and must be refreshed manually — see the README for how to retrieve one.
